pretreatments.description: Chemical pretreatment using sodium hydroxide (NaOH) reagent, alkaline treatment, with reagent dosage ranging from 0–4 mmol/g VS, process duration from 1–24 h, and temperature variations set at 25 and 90 °C under three condition sets (A, B, C) to investigate alkaline reagent effect.
